scope: EXT-D-0170 scoped independent source review of the native SEO driver sequence repair

prior_findings.finding: A direct return before the actual runSeoCaseSequence call leaves the prior guard green
prior_findings.evidence: The new assertReachable rejects an in-memory direct-return mutation of the actual exercisePanel body with 'native panel sequence is reachable'.

prior_findings.finding: A direct return at the start of the controlled callback leaves the prior guard green
prior_findings.evidence: The new assertReachable rejects an in-memory direct-return mutation of the actual controlled callback with 'controlled phase is reachable'.

verdict_a_native_acceptance_readiness.evidence: The current driver still directly awaits runSeoCaseSequence with controlled T14 social copy and T02 changed-metadata recapture before the volatile manual detail phase. The source guard passes, and focused source/oracle tests pass.
verdict_a_native_acceptance_readiness.limit: No native browser or build was run in this review. Real T02/T14 behavior and full EXT-D-0170 acceptance remain unverified.

verdict_b_source_guard_quality_and_ci.ci_registration: PASS: package.json test:focused-acceptance includes seo-driver-sequence.test.mjs, and both .github/workflows/focused-acceptance.yml and ci.yml invoke that command.

finding.detail: alwaysExits does not analyze a TryStatement or a truthy numeric condition. In-memory mutations of the actual driver inserting `try { return; } finally {}` before runSeoCaseSequence or at the start of the controlled callback both pass inspectDriverSequence. `if (1) return;` at the start of the controlled callback also passes. These are unconditional early exits that skip the retained sequence or T14/T02 work, so the prior bypass class is still not fully guarded.
finding.impact: A driver that silently skips independent observations can remain green in focused CI despite retaining all expected call syntax.

verdict_b_source_guard_quality_and_ci.new_breakage: No regression in the unchanged driver observed; the repair's reachability logic has the bypass above.

verification.mutations: Against the actual driver source and extracted inspectDriverSequence: direct sequence and controlled returns rejected; try/finally returns in both positions and literal-true controlled return passed the guard.
